project_manifesto.title: Minimalist Architect Publication
project_manifesto.persona: Amir Mohammad Najafi (@njfamirm) - Software Architect & Tech Lead at Nexim.

theme.palette: Strict Monochrome. Pure Black (#000000), Pure White (#FFFFFF), and Zinc-Grays for borders. Absolutely NO other colors.
theme.mode: System-preference (prefers-color-scheme). Automatic dark/light mode switching based on user's system settings.

typography.mono: Fira Code for ALL headings (h1, h2, etc.), technical labels, dates, metadata, and code blocks.
typography.STRICT_RULE: NO Persian fonts. NO Vazirmatn. Use pure modern sans-serif and monospace fonts.

elements: High-definition SVG Hatch Pattern (45-degree diagonal lines) at 0.05 opacity. Must be sharp.

layout.system: Bento Grid implemented via strict CSS Grid.
layout.constraints: Max-width 1536px (2xl). Centered. 1px explicit borders on every block.

brightness_button_design.description: All interactive elements use reversed color hover effect (brightness button pattern).
applies_to: All clickable elements throughout the app

hover_logic.target: INTERACTIVE_ELEMENTS_ONLY (Article cards, buttons, and all links).
hover_logic.static_blocks: The main Statement block and other non-link containers must remain STATIC. No hover effects.
hover_logic.effect: Brightness Button Design - Complete color reversal. Background becomes foreground color, text becomes background color. Instant flip (duration-0). No fade, no transition, no opacity changes.

grid_areas.style: Massive typography, takes up significant grid space.

grid_areas.content: A vertical list of the 5 most recent articles. Each item must show: Title, one-line summary, and Monospace metadata (Date/Tags).
linkedin.com/in/njfamirm-me, github.com/njfamirm, medium.com/@njfamirm, njfamirm@gmail.com. Monospace text links only.

strict_negative_constraints: FATAL ERROR if ANY 3D elements or WebGL code is included.
FATAL ERROR if non-clickable blocks (like the hero statement) have hover effects.
FATAL ERROR if Search, Portfolio, or Skills sections are added.
FATAL ERROR if any colors other than Black, White, or Zinc-Grays are used.
FATAL ERROR if there is any transition/fade delay on hover states.
FATAL ERROR if Persian fonts are present.
